reason: This passage (Exodus 19:10-24) describes God's instructions to Moses regarding the consecration and preparation of the Israelites before the theophany at Mount Sinai. The text focuses on religious preparation, holiness requirements, and boundaries around the sacred mountain. It contains no mention of oppression, persecution, mistreatment, or suffering of the Hebrews as a people. The Israelites are being prepared for a divine encounter, not depicted as oppressed or persecuted.
